subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action refresh be accepted after direct upstream-source verification, or should sensitive action bumps such as Codex and credential-bearing Docker/token actions be split for separate review?
rationale: These pins execute third-party code with secrets or elevated repository capabilities, and the required direct Codex source gate was not available to this review.

options.title: Verify and merge the group
options.body: Rebase, inspect the sensitive upstream commits directly, and merge the grouped refresh after exact-head workflow gates complete.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Move Codex, app-token, Docker login/build, and CodeQL updates into separately reviewed PRs while retaining routine setup-action bumps here.

options.title: Pause this refresh
options.body: Close or defer the grouped update if the direct source-review cost outweighs the immediate dependency benefit.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge the group
recommendation.body: Rebase, inspect the sensitive upstream commits directly, and merge the grouped refresh after exact-head workflow gates complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release and CI workflow history makes this handle the strongest available owner for the security-versus-maintenance tradeoff.
